name: Grasping Earth
summary: Wraps a target in grasping earth that restrains on a successful Aether test.
rulesText: You shape loose earth around a creature into grasping forms that close around its body. Make an Aether Test against the target's Strength Resistance.
success: The target is Restrained while the spell is maintained.
resisted: The earth catches around the target's legs and reduces its movement by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Compression
summary: Crushes a target with compressed Aether, dealing full or reduced impact damage.
rulesText: You force the Aether surrounding a creature inward, briefly subjecting it to intense physical pressure. Make an Aether Test against the target's appropriate Resistance.
success: The target suffers 2d6 Impact damage and is pushed 5 feet.
